posts.caption: Catch Isabel Hagen fresh from her TV special, "Isabel Hagen at the Bitter End." 🎤 Houston, this is your chance to see her unique spin on stand-up. Isabel's mix of existential humor and viola is unmatched. She’s known for weaving anxiety and life as a classical musician into her sets, making you laugh and think.
